note: Claims about the installed command surface, verified by scripts/scan-command-surface.mjs. Every hostOnly entry carries an anchor that must still appear in the command file, and every verb claim names a handler symbol that must still exist at the cited path. Nothing here is prose a reader has to trust: if a claim rots, tests/command-surface.test.mjs fails.

classes.A: The CLI verb performs the work. The host renders its JSON and derives no state. Gaps listed under cliGaps must be closed in the CLI, with tests, before the command is thinned.
classes.B: The command owns orchestration no verb performs. The CLI takes the derivable state; the host keeps the named capabilities. Thinning to a renderer would delete them.
classes.C: No legion verb exists. Placement is undecided; see P16-B009.

commands.rationale: The verb does the real work: refreshCodebaseMap, currentCodebaseFingerprint, and queryCodebaseMap are deterministic and produce the map artifacts directly. No executor is involved.

hostOnly.capability: Offer a refresh rather than performing one when invoked with no flags
hostOnly.anchor: otherwise summarize the current dataset and offer refresh via AskUserQuestion

cliGaps: legion map with no flags refreshes immediately (mapRefresh); the command offers the choice first. Either the CLI gains a no-flag summary mode or the host keeps the prompt.

commands.rationale: The verb is a deterministic state machine over milestones.json with define, complete, archive, and status modes, each validated. It is not executor-backed and needs no model to run.

hostOnly.capability: Menu of available milestone actions
Routing a menu selection to the matching mode

commands.rationale: The verb is executor-backed but purpose-built: it reads workflow state and recent guidance runs, and asks for retrospective sections specifically. The command file declares the Agent tool but contains no dispatch specification; its Agent references are retrospective content about which agents were used, not dispatch.

hostOnly.capability: Save-or-discard choice over the retrospective

cliGaps: legion retro accepts --phase and --milestone only. The command's cross-project mode has no verb equivalent.

commands.rationale: The verb writes the lesson and maintains knowledge-index.json deterministically. No executor is involved.

hostOnly.capability: Continuation prompt after recording a lesson

cliGaps: legion learn records only. The command's recall mode (--recall) has no verb equivalent.
The command's list mode (--list) has no verb equivalent.
The command's prune mode (--prune) has no verb equivalent.

commands.rationale: The verb validates committed project state under .legion/project deterministically, which is the whole of what this command should assert.
cliGaps: legion validate has no --fix. The command's auto-fix pass has no verb equivalent.
legion validate has no --ci. The command's CI mode has no verb equivalent.
The command's agent-roster consistency check reads the .planning/ agent catalog. It retires with .planning/ rather than moving to the CLI; record the removal as deliberate.

commands.rationale: The verb runs one executor pass against fixed sections and writes one artifact. The command runs a divergent design conversation: an entry-path choice, a bounded research pass, an iterative clarifying interview over eight named decisions, and an approach-comparison loop. Rendering the verb's payload would delete all of it. Exploration is the one place the governing plan deliberately grants wide latitude, so this is the command least safe to thin.

hostOnly.capability: Entry-path choice: fresh idea, existing exploration, or project context
Bounded local and web research pass recorded as facts, inferences, and assumptions
Iterative clarifying interview, one material decision at a time, updating design constraints between answers
hostOnly.anchor: 4. CLARIFY ONE DECISION AT A TIME

hostOnly.capability: Two to three approaches with tradeoffs and a choose, refine, or keep-comparing loop

commands.rationale: The CLI owns the taskgraph, the risk classification, and the decision that planning is complete. Agent recommendation, human confirmation, and issue creation are host work.

hostOnly.capability: Agent recommendation per plan
Human confirmation of the decomposition before files are written
GitHub issue creation

commands.rationale: The verb creates a typed change, oracle, and taskgraph and stops, routing execution to legion build. Everything the command does after planning is host work. The handler is shared with polish, so the verb name alone says nothing about behaviour.

hostOnly.capability: Agent selection for the task
Commit offer after files change
Inline review pass in fix mode
PR creation in fix mode

commands.rationale: The verb creates a typed taskgraph scoped to the target and stops. The dry run, the behaviour-preservation check, and the commit step are host work.

hostOnly.capability: Dry-run preview before any edit
Post-polish safety verification that behaviour is unchanged
Report and commit step

commands.rationale: The CLI owns verification, diff reconciliation, and the task verdict. The wave executor, its disjointness proof, and its gates are host work with no verb equivalent.

hostOnly.capability: Wave A analysis dispatch and the architecture review gate
Wave B parallel dispatch across execution and remediation streams
hostOnly.anchor: Spawn Wave B agents in parallel

hostOnly.capability: File-overlap safety check that serializes waves whose write scopes intersect

commands.rationale: The CLI owns the verification report, the gate set, and human acceptance. The multi-agent review panel and its routing are host work.

hostOnly.capability: Intent detection over natural-language invocation
Review agent selection
Review cycle execution with glob-routed fix agents
Security-only output mode

cliGaps: legion review must expose what a panel needs before commands/review.md is thinned, not after.

commands.rationale: The verb runs release readiness gates. It does not publish or release, so PR creation, pushing, and post-ship observation cannot move into it.

hostOnly.capability: PR creation and pushing
Post-ship verification and canary monitoring

commands.rationale: The verb runs one executor pass against fixed sections and writes one advisory artifact. It selects no specialist and supports no second turn, so a chosen advisor and a multi-turn consultation would both be lost.

hostOnly.capability: Advisor selection with personality injection
Follow-up consultation turns against the same advisor
Read-only enforcement on the advisory dispatch

commands.rationale: The verb shares one generic implementation with explore and produces a single decision artifact. The command is a deliberating panel. Preserving the /legion:board name is necessary and not sufficient: the defining behaviour is the panel, not the label.

hostOnly.capability: Board composition: a user-confirmed slate of members
Three to five independent assessments with quorum and abstention on timeout
Vote tally and escalated tie resolution
hostOnly.anchor: ESCALATED: Present the tie to the user

hostOnly.capability: Three-stage guided identity, capability, and registry-tag capture
Schema validation of the generated personality
